strava-orange.$description: Strava Orange — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Inline text links and policy references; the only secondary chromatic color and reserved strictly for navigational links

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

warm-linen.$description: Warm Linen — Footer background, secondary surface elevation, subtle banding beneath white

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary body and heading text, icon strokes, hairline borders, button outlines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Button text, filled icon strokes, high-contrast warm near-black

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary body text, nav links, metadata — warm dark gray for sub-headings and long-form copy

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted helper text, tertiary copy, placeholder labels

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, input outlines, dividers between secondary sections

boathouse.$description: Sole typeface across all UI, headings, body, nav, and footer. The weight contrast is deliberately binary — 400 for almost everything, 600 reserved for the wordmark, headings, and CTA labels. Tight line-heights (1.0 on display) give headings a compressed, assertive posture rather than the airy SaaS default.
